messages:
ajay_sales: Heads-up — Enterprise prospect EdgeSense asking for a one-time bulk credits package + custom payment terms. Need approvals asap, pitching tomorrow.
priya_ae: Context: they're an industrial IoT vendor, expect heavy embeddings + low-latency inference. Forecasted 12mo spend ~$300k. Asking for 35% off list + net-60 and onboarding credits $20k.
maria_finance: 35% is large. Do we have logo/reference, proof of concept success, and expected monthly burn profile? Also need rationale (strategic customer / channel partner / pilot-to-scale).
ajay_sales: They want a pilot first (3mo), then scale. Logo + LOI available. Burn profile: month1 low (pilot), month4+ steady ~25-30k/mo. LOI attached: https://company.share/edgesense-loi (internal link).
kevin_revops: Moving to deal desk. Quick economics: if ARR ~$300k and discount 35% -> revenue $195k; that could push below our minimum pricing thresholds. Suggest we trade discount for a commitment or prepay.
sarah_legal: Also need to check data residency + IP clauses for pilot. They want longer retention for logs. I'll need a redline on the SOW and a security addendum. Don't sign net-60 before Legal + SOC2 confirmation.
ajay_sales: Understood. They do require SOC2 or equivalent. They can accept a security questionnaire exchange, but prefer vendor attestation.
priya_ae: Proposal from my side: offer 25% discount + $15k onboarding credit, 12-mo minimum, net-30 standard OR net-60 if they prepay first 3 months. Also include clause: credits expire after 6 months.
maria_finance: That sounds reasonable. Need to lock gross margin floor. Can we include a ramp clause: if usage > projected by month 6, discount to be re-evaluated? Also require payment mechanics in contract (ACH/wire only for prepay).
kevin_revops: I'll draft the commercial memo for Deal Desk. Short summary to include: customer, ARR, proposed discount, payment terms, onboarding credit, legal conditions, upsell guardrail (re-eval at month6). I'll attach the memo here when done.
opsbot: deploy-billing-notice: Created internal deal ticket DD-2026-118. Link: https://redwood.internal/deal/DD-2026-118
sarah_legal: If Finance + RevOps sign off, Legal can fast-track a SOW addendum. Need SOC2 doc + minimal edits to our IP/data clauses. Also request Customer Security Questionnaire (CSQ) response timeline.
ajay_sales: I'll push customer to agree to 12-mo commit and prepay option during the pitch. If they push net-60 without prepay, we'll present counteroffer with reduced discount.
maria_finance: Conditional approval from Finance: approve 25% discount + $15k onboarding credits if customer signs 12mo and either prepay 3mo or agrees to revenue recognition schedule per ARR guidance. No net-60 unless prepay. Please add these conditions to the deal memo.
kevin_revops: Added conditions to DD ticket and commercial memo draft: "Finance conditional approval = 25% discount + $15k credit; 12mo commit; prepay-first-3mo OR net-30". Attaching memo now.
priya_ae: Thanks all. I'll present the counter and try to lock prepay. Will update thread after tomorrow's pitch. :crossed_fingers:
ajay_sales: One more ask — can we get a waiver for the standard onboarding SLA penalty in case of integration delays? Customer worried about ramp risk.
maria_finance: We can allow a one-time extension (max 30 days) on SLA milestones, but cap penalty exposure at $5k. Include as exception in memo.
kevin_revops: Final checklist for approvals: Finance sign-off (maria_finance) ✅; RevOps memo filed (kevin_revops) ✅; Legal pre-clear (sarah_legal) pending receipt of SOC2; Sales to secure LOI and prepay decision.
priya_ae: LOI is signed, SOC2 in progress — they said delivery in 5 business days. I'll push for prepay in the pitch. Thanks everyone.
ajay_sales: Closing loop later today. If customer accepts prepay + 12mo, we can finalize a commercial term sheet and route to Legal for SOW addendum. :thumbsup:
